version.changelog: Add Trust & security section: canonical npm/PyPI links, test key and billing alerts, webhook signature validation, privacy/data note, usage monitoring.

llm.summary: The skill's requirements and instructions are consistent with a third‑party outbound voice-call API: it only asks for a single API key and provides SDK/CLI install and usage instructions, with no unexpected file or credential access.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (AI phone calls) align with the declared requirement (PAMELA_API_KEY) and the SKILL.md, which documents SDKs, CLI, and example API calls. Nothing requested appears unrelated to making phone calls.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md contains normal usage instructions (npm/pip installs, environment variable usage, example API calls, webhook verification). It does not instruct reading arbitrary local files, shell history, or unrelated environment variables. It warns about webhook signature verification and data handling.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: This is an instruction-only skill (no install spec and no code files). The doc recommends installing packages from npm/PyPI (expected for an SDK). Because installation is left to the user, verify package names on the official registries to avoid typosquatting before running installs.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Only a single API credential (PAMELA_API_KEY) is required and documented. That is proportional to the described functionality. The SKILL.md does not access other secrets or config paths.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Skill is not always-enabled and does not request persistent system privileges. It does not modify other skills or system config. Autonomous invocation is allowed (platform default) but not combined with other red flags.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears internally consistent, but take normal cautions before installing/using: 1) Verify the vendor and package names on npm and PyPI (typosquatting is common). 2) Use a restricted/test API key (not a full production key) while evaluating. 3) Review billing terms — calls are billed ($0.10/min, minimum 1 min) and can incur charges. 4) Expect audio and transcripts to be sent to the vendor; read their privacy/data retention docs and avoid sending sensitive information. 5) If you receive webhooks, implement X-Pamela-Signature verification as recommended. 6) Confirm the homepage/developer domain and look up the SDK packages' publisher info on the registries before running any install commands.
